complete_named_RAW_REVIEW_payload.designation: Exact complete raw bytes, no deletion; all full seven-slot decisions, binder/definition audit, source graph/inventory, finite evidence and negative boundaries included.

internal_lets.name: μ
internal_lets.semantics: Normalized Gibbs measure using exp(-V)/integral exp(-V). Mathlib may return zero for nonintegrable density, but IsProbabilityMeasure μ is a produced conclusion; inherited actual64 must discharge normalization from original hypotheses, not a caller integrability assumption.

internal_lets.name: J
internal_lets.semantics: Actual joint law (X,X+sqrt eta Z), independent X and standard Gaussian Z; matches pi_eta. J is a measure, not inverse J from informal source planning; actual inverse name is Inv.

internal_lets.name: ν
internal_lets.semantics: Actual Y marginal.

internal_lets.name: Λ
internal_lets.semantics: Actual pair (Y+,Y-); source exchangeability/same marginal conclusions are produced.

internal_lets.name: F
internal_lets.semantics: Actual reflection involution.

internal_lets.name: mY
internal_lets.semantics: Sigma-algebra of Y-only observables.

internal_lets.name: letI MeasurableSpace(E×E)
internal_lets.semantics: Internal actual product measurable structure, not a caller binder.

internal_lets.name: letI Fact(mY≤ambient)
internal_lets.semantics: Internally derived inclusion of Y sigma-algebra in product sigma-algebra.

internal_lets.name: HP
internal_lets.semantics: Closed real scalar-valued L2 subspace of a.e. Y-measurable functions; range equality with P is output.

internal_lets.name: P
internal_lets.semantics: Ambient bounded orthogonal conditional-expectation projection; condExpL2 is projection onto lpMeas, inclusion embeds its result into joint L2.

internal_lets.name: hp
internal_lets.semantics: Definitional pushforward measure preservation, internally constructed from measurable_snd and ν=J.snd.

internal_lets.name: M
internal_lets.semantics: Actual marginal-to-joint pullback u↦u(Y), isometric.

internal_lets.name: A
internal_lets.semantics: Actual macroscopic compression PUP on HP.

internal_lets.name: B
internal_lets.semantics: Actual leakage into ambient joint L2; outputs P(B f)=0 establish microscopic membership.

internal_lets.name: ΓP
internal_lets.semantics: SAME Γ transported by e; means e Γ e^-1, not a separately chosen root or norm number.

internal_lets.name: qP
internal_lets.semantics: Actual constant-one vector transported to HP.

internal_lets.name: HP0
internal_lets.semantics: Exact centered macroscopic space within HP. innerSL qP f=<qP,f>; output equivalence identifies zero integral under ν. Not all centered joint L2.

internal_lets.name: letI NormedAddCommGroup HP0
internal_lets.semantics: Inherited subtype norm/additive structure; no renorming or premise.

internal_lets.name: letI InnerProductSpace ℝ HP0
internal_lets.semantics: Inherited subtype inner product.

internal_lets.name: letI CompleteSpace HP0
internal_lets.semantics: Internal completeness of closed continuous-functional kernel in complete HP. Does not restrict source inputs; ensures genuine Hilbert adjoints.

internal_lets.name: γ
internal_lets.semantics: Exact positive scalar gamma_gap, distinct from operator ΓP/ΓP0. Positivity is produced.

internal_lets.name: Hperp
internal_lets.semantics: EXACT microscopic space ker actual P within joint L2: conditional mean zero given Y. Globally mean zero follows under produced probability law; converse fails.

internal_lets.name: letI NormedAddCommGroup Hperp
internal_lets.semantics: Inherited joint-L2 subtype norm/additive structure.

internal_lets.name: letI InnerProductSpace ℝ Hperp
internal_lets.semantics: Inherited joint-L2 subtype inner product.

internal_lets.name: letI CompleteSpace Hperp
internal_lets.semantics: Internal completeness of closed kernel of bounded P; no caller complete-space certificate.

literal_let_lines: HP := lpMeas ℝ ℝ mY 2 J
P : Lp ℝ 2 J →L[ℝ] Lp ℝ 2 J :=
hp : MeasurePreserving (Prod.snd : E × E → E) J ν := ⟨measurable_snd,rfl⟩
M : Lp ℝ 2 ν →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Lp ℝ 2 J := Lp.compMeasurePreservingₗᵢ ℝ Prod.snd hp

produced_existential_witnesses.name: S
produced_existential_witnesses.semantics: Produced actual conditional law of Y- given Y+ with explicit normalized density; IsMarkovKernel, disintegration and both marginals output.

produced_existential_witnesses.name: e
produced_existential_witnesses.semantics: Produced isometric equivalence equal to actual pullback M, so transport is source-fixed.

produced_existential_witnesses.name: U
produced_existential_witnesses.semantics: Produced actual reflection pullback a.e.; involutive and self-adjoint. Its onto consequence concerns U, never V0.

produced_existential_witnesses.name: T
produced_existential_witnesses.semantics: Produced actual conditional-expectation macro operator, self-adjoint contraction and mean preserving.

produced_existential_witnesses.name: Γ
produced_existential_witnesses.semantics: Produced positive root of I-T². Positive-root uniqueness identifies exact source square root.

produced_existential_witnesses.name: q
produced_existential_witnesses.semantics: Produced constant-one a.e. vector with Tq=q and inner/integral identity.

produced_existential_witnesses.name: ΓP0
produced_existential_witnesses.semantics: Produced restriction of SAME ΓP by forall-f inclusion equality, positive and Loewner≥γI; IsUnit is conclusion.

produced_existential_witnesses.name: Inv
produced_existential_witnesses.semantics: Produced genuine bounded two-sided inverse of ΓP0 with norm≤1/γ; no full-HP inverse claimed.

produced_existential_witnesses.name: B0
produced_existential_witnesses.semantics: Produced typed restriction/codomain restriction of actual B by forall-f ambient inclusion equality.

produced_existential_witnesses.name: V0
produced_existential_witnesses.semantics: Produced polar isometry tied to B0∘Inv; factorization, V*V=I and norm equality are conclusions, not certificates.

nodes.content: V:C2(Rd), 0<alpha<=beta; alpha I<=Hess V(x)<=beta I for every x. eta in (0,1/beta]. mu=Z^-1 exp(-V) dx; pi_eta proportional exp(-V(x)-||x-y||^2/(2eta)) dxdy. All L2 functions real scalar valued, almost-everywhere equivalence classes.

H=L2(pi_eta); P=conditional expectation given Y, HP=ran P (functions of y), Hperp=ker P=ran(I-P)=HP orthogonal complement. Hperp consists of conditional mean-zero functions for nu-a.e.y, with inherited H inner product and complete closed-subspace Hilbert structure.

HP0=HP intersect L2_0(pi_eta), isometrically identified with L2_0(nu), nu=pi_eta^Y. Its vectors are actual y-only L2 observables with total integral zero, not all globally centered joint observables. Use exact inclusion i0:HP0->HP. Hperp subset L2_0(pi_eta), but converse fails.
U f(x,y)=f(x,2x-y), self-adjoint unitary from actual law. A=U_PP:HP->HP, B=U_perpP:HP->Hperp. First index target. B*B=I-A^2 on HP.
Gamma_P=(I-A^2)^(1/2) unique nonnegative bounded root on HP; B*B=Gamma_P^2 and ||Bf||=||Gamma_P f|| for every f in HP. Constant functions lie in full root kernel.

nodes.anchor: A2.E12; A2.E15; prose immediately preceding A2.E16
nodes.content: rho_mac=(1-alpha eta)/(1+alpha eta); gamma_gap=2 sqrt(alpha eta)/(1+alpha eta)>0. SAME Gamma_P restricted/transported to exact HP0 obeys Gamma0>=gamma_gap I in Loewner order, hence genuine bounded two-sided inverse J on HP0. Inv lower/upper identities and norm bound <=1/gamma_gap are outputs of this inherited branch. No full-HP inverse.

B0=B restricted from exact HP0 with codomain exact Hperp. Inclusions preserve actual action: i_perp B0 = B_ambient i0. Gram B0* B0=Gamma0^2 and norm equality use inherited Hilbert structures; B0 is not an arbitrary chosen map. For g in Hperp, the full-HP adjoint B* g lies in HP0 because B annihilates constants, and i0(B0* g)=B* g; this compatibility must be produced internally.
V_perpP=B0 J : HP0->Hperp, B0=V_perpP Gamma0, and V_perpP* V_perpP=I_HP0. All maps bounded real-linear. For every v in HP0, ||Vv||=||v||; isometric embedding without onto Hperp.

There exist universal c,C>0 such that if beta eta<=c, then ||(I+H_perpperp) V v||^2<=C log(1/gamma_gap)||Gamma_P v||^2 for every v in HP0. This is a later halfturn estimate using B16, not a B16 hypothesis or closure.

For f in L2_0(pi_eta), fP=Pf in HP0 and fperp=(I-P)f in Hperp; fV=V* fperp in HP0. B0* fperp=Gamma0 fV. V fV=VV* fperp is orthogonal projection onto ran V and ||fV||<=||fperp||. Components perpendicular to ran V are killed by B0*. Thus fP,fV share HP0 for C=1/2(||fP||^2-||fV||^2)-<A Gamma0^-1 fP,fV>. Printed B3 fixes 0<rho<=1/2 and omega>0 for the corrector analysis; these are not B16 parameters.

B13 produces H1 smoothing of A f for every L2 f. B14 has macro norm bound and independent floor A>=-I/2. Their source proof may establish prior B15; neither an H1 assumption on a caller vector nor the lower-floor certificate is needed anew to normalize B once B11 and the exact B15 inverse are inherited. The macro norm-bound half of B14 is upstream provenance for B15; the lower-floor half is a separate estimate and is not needed for B16.

Real L2 on probability measure; all indicated operators bounded unless stated; adjoints characterized by inner product; Loewner order quadratic-form universal over vectors; spectral Borel calculus and unique nonnegative root. D1 does not separately print arbitrary-pair positive-root monotonicity.
